styles.name: Patchbay
styles.coreTrick: Near-black ground with hairline-edged rounded cards where brand hues are contrast-pushed into small ports, dots and tag chips, cabled together by a procedural node graph, while the one main action is a neutral ink pill instead of the brand colour.
styles.colourRecipe: Primary, secondary and accent are each pushed toward black or white until they hold 3:1 on the ground, card and inset field and a 4.5:1 label sits on them (pbTone); the main action is ink not primary; a muted client colour is mixed toward ink until 4.6:1 on five beds.

remainder.what: Dual-condition contrast search for port/tag colours (3:1 on three beds AND 4.5:1 label)
remainder.whyCode: Two-sided colour search with a fallback nudge loop, not a formula

remainder.what: Cursor and name-tag bezier geometry plus label-width estimate
Node-graph composition: fixed module boxes, port coordinates, wire routing table
remainder.whyCode: Layout is hard-coded coordinates; generator would need a graph spec

remainder.what: Brand name fit into a 118-unit module
Light-mode ink pill and 3n+k nth-of-type colour cycling depend on DOM order
remainder.whyCode: Structural selectors tied to board markup

styles.notes: Coverage counts css-recipe/tokens/svg-generator moves only; contrast-floor-push is needs-code and excluded. App screens carry no art by hard rule (css 13), so node-graph-diagram and dot-grid-glow-backdrop are board/deck only.

styles.name: Pirate Broadcast
styles.coreTrick: A black teletext screen on a 40-column character grid in eight fixed hardware colours (brand colour reduced to the station ident), with a 5x7 bitmap font rendered as double-height SVG headline and a banded glitch frame-grab intruding on it.
styles.colourRecipe: Client primary is used only as the ident (mark, P100, inverse headline block), lifted toward white until 4.6:1 on black; every other on-screen colour is a fixed teletext hue; secondary/accent are off-screen only; light mode keeps a pale wall with black screens.

remainder.what: Test card SVG: fixed bars, castellations, grey ramp, grating, circle ident with copy slots
5x7 punctuation table the shared font lacks
panels hook that string-replaces markup to inject P101-P103 title rows and the test card
remainder.whyCode: DOM-shape surgery on shared panel HTML

remainder.what: Signal-bar icon drawn with stacked gradients per state, RGB-split pressed state
Teletext hero page: row 0/24 absolute layout and torn grab message box
remainder.whyCode: Absolute percentage layout tied to art markup

remainder.what: Deck materialArt hook returning the test card

styles.notes: Roughly half the look is the fixed illustration/hero page. The fixed palette lives in tokens() but the style's identity is the grid + bitmap headline.

styles.name: Pixel Arcade
styles.coreTrick: Everything snaps to a 4px grid: borders are four-shadow stacks that notch corners, shading is a 2x2 checker dither, the main button has a 4px underside that vanishes on press, and the hero is a rects-only pixel landscape with the brand initial as a sprite.
styles.colourRecipe: Primary, secondary and accent are used raw for fills (button, landscape, collectibles) with deep/hi shades derived by mixing toward black/white (p-deep 58%, p-hi 30%); dark canvas is clamped to L<=12% as a night sky; panels are canvas lifted one ink step; accent text is shaded to read as text.

remainder.what: Heading-face-dependent scaling (Press Start 2P 0.62, pixel face 0.92, VT323 UI x1.36, smoothing)
remainder.whyCode: Reads the selected font class and name at runtime

remainder.what: Landscape drawing: hand-placed stars, moon spans, clouds, pines, gems, sine-wave hills
Heart and HUD sprite bitmaps and score overlay
remainder.whyCode: Pixel bitmap data plus HTML overlay

remainder.what: Silkscreen font load side effect inside tokens()/art()
RPG dialog box with blinking ▼ and tab kicker
remainder.whyCode: Bespoke hero copy container tied to scene hero

styles.notes: Stepped-border and press-travel are strongly reusable by other pixel styles; the landscape is mostly bespoke.

styles.name: Radical Memphis
styles.coreTrick: Surfaces are paper cabinets, each carrying a different laminate (squiggle, terrazzo, checker, dots, zig-zag) as a side strip or fill, and every shape gets a second-hue offset sheet (the other brand hue mixed into the canvas) instead of an outline or black shadow, with objects tilted on diagonals.
styles.colourRecipe: Primary is the dominant flat, secondary the second laminate, accent one screamer; the offset sheet is the secondary mixed 45% into the canvas behind primary shapes and the primary mixed 50% elsewhere; cards are always paper (white mixed into the light brand colour) with black/soft ink; canvas warmed toward #F6F1E7.

remainder.what: headline(): regex split of lead words onto paper slabs and last word on a secondary slab
Showroom totem composition: 10 hand-placed shapes with percent coordinates and rotations
deck.product room-set (frame, floor, totem, side table, plaque with year)
Bacterio squiggle data-URI tile artwork
Soft ink loop to hold 4.5:1 on paper

styles.notes: Offset sheet colour logic and laminate fills are the transferable core; the slab headline and totem are bespoke. Slabs avoid CSS masks for html2canvas export safety (css 16, 195-203).

styles.name: Raw Brutalist
styles.coreTrick: Strip every effect: zero radius, 2px ink borders, no shadows, mono uppercase bracketed labels and controls that invert (ink fill, canvas text) on hover and flip back on press, with an enormous bleeding uppercase headline over visible 12-column grid lines.
styles.colourRecipe: Client canvas is replaced by pure white (or #0a0a0a dark); ink is the border/text colour; primary appears only on the single CTA block and switch-on, secondary on status cells, accent only as a highlighter band behind one word; links use a fixed default blue; muted is mixed toward ink until 4.6:1.
